name: SmartArtQuickStyles
description: Represents a collection of SmartArtQuickStyle objects.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Gets an Application object that represents the container application for the SmartArtQuickStyles object. Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Gets a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the SmartArtQuickStyles object was created. Read-only.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Retrieves the count of the number of SmartArtQuickStyle objects contained within the SmartArtQuickStyles collection. Read-only.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Retrieves a SmartArtQuickStyle object at the specified index or with the specified unique Id.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: Specifies either an integer representing the index or a string representing the location of the SmartArtQuickStyle object.
